description: The Ohio State Infrared Imager/Spectrometer (OSIRIS) was a facility near-infrared camera and multi-mode spectrograph mounted on the CTIO Blanco 4-meter and 1.5-meter telescopes, operating in the 1–2.5 micron wavelength regime.
short_description: Ohio State Infrared Imager/Spectrometer (OSIRIS) filters at CTIO
facility_description: Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) operates astronomical telescopes on Cerro Tololo in Chile, managed by NSF NOIRLab.
notes: OSIRIS was developed by Ohio State University and used at CTIO. Transmission curves are historical CTIO data without an explicit open redistribution licence.
